subObjectOperations.name: Bevel
subObjectOperations.parameterPolicy: Prefer labeled Height/Outline. A declared reference_geometry_ratio approximation can supply missing lengths with full before/final evidence and a verified known dimension. Never treat cursor XYZ or raw drag pixels as lengths.
subObjectOperations.selectionPolicy: Face IDs are logical children with a topology revision, never separate scene nodes. Verify local geometry or use an unambiguous local-axis extreme plane.
subObjectOperations.warning: Editable Poly polygon Bevel is not the Bevel modifier. Bottom XYZ is not Height/Outline. Edit Poly modifier editing is not yet supported by this backend.
subObjectOperations.evidenceStatus: official_documentation; not an exhaustive live control scan

interactionModel.warning: The panel is object- and modifier-dependent; re-observe it after every selection or stack change.
